Tells which joystick the user used last.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
While Not KeyHit(1)
	Cls
	Text 10, 10, "Last joystick: " + LastJoyDevice()
	Flip
Wend
```
@returns The number of the joystick, or -1 if none was used yet.
@gap This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
